tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('daily_cost_4.csv')

# For each (account, service), compute rolling median excluding self to detect spikes
df = df.sort_values(['SubAccountName','ServiceName','ChargePeriodStart']).reset_index(drop=True)

results = []
for (acc, svc), g in df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName']):
    g = g.sort_values('ChargePeriodStart').reset_index(drop=True)
    x = g['BilledCost'].values
    n = len(x)
    # robust z-score using median and MAD of the series
    med = np.median(x)
    mad = np.median(np.abs(x - med)) + 1e-9
    z = (x - med) / (1.4826 * mad)
    g = g.assign(z=z)
    results.append(g.loc[g['z'].idxmax(), ['ChargePeriodStart','SubAccountName','ServiceName','BilledCost','z']])

res = pd.DataFrame(results)
print(res.sort_values('z', ascending=False).head(10))
